description: Elenco depuratori pubblici del Veneto (anni 2013-2022) is a dataset listed in Italian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Regione Veneto. Elenco dei depuratori pubblici (impianti di trattamento delle acque reflue urbane) del Veneto, per Comune, aprile 2022. Per maggiori informazioni vai alle sezione Indicatori Ambientali del Veneto - Idrosfera - Conformità dei sistemi di depurazione delle acque reflue urbane. Coverage: Regione Veneto. The portal files it under the publisher Regione Veneto. Its tags are acque-reflue-urbane, ambiente, depuratori, idrosfera, matrice-arpav---idrosfera. It offers 1 resource(s) in HTML. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support wastewater and sewer network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-it-portal.
